verdict.root_cause: At 14:02:13, three minutes before onset, platform-automation set QUOTE_SERVICE_ADDR on shippingservice to a host whose name indicates it no longer exists, and unlike the four earlier occurrences of the same edit it was never reverted [tr_87a2126c167b]. With that value in effect shippingservice accepts well-formed GetQuoteRequests but never emits a quote response, ship-order or tracking line, a clear departure from the complete sequence logged an hour earlier [tr_239a7a606a6c]. checkoutservice consequently fails on the shipping-quote branch: in 10/10 sampled failing traces the deepest, earliest error span is its client call to ShippingService/GetQuote, with all sibling dependencies clean [tr_4c3989b6e8d3], and checkouts stall at or before payment [tr_92fe6efb6816], which explains the later alerts from accounting, email, fraud-detection and quoteservice. The mechanism is a configuration value naming an unreachable quote endpoint; the wrongness of that value is what breaks the request.
verdict.reasoning: Traces localise the failure to the checkoutservice->shippingservice GetQuote edge and exonerate cartservice, productcatalogservice, currencyservice and the cart Redis hop [tr_4c3989b6e8d3]; checkoutservice has no recorded changes at all [tr_6f5d83fc954b], so the caller did not change. At the callee, inbound requests keep arriving and are structurally valid but responses stop being logged, with no validation, decode, panic or restart messages [tr_239a7a606a6c] - the shape of a service unable to reach its quote target rather than failing internally. Timing closes it: the unreverted QUOTE_SERVICE_ADDR edit at 14:02:13 [tr_87a2126c167b] precedes checkoutservice's error-ratio change point at 14:03:30 [tr_184ca8359959] by ~75 seconds. Not dependency_latency: erroring GetQuote spans are ~2.6-3.7ms in 8.5-11.3ms traces, prompt error returns far short of any deadline [tr_4c3989b6e8d3]. Not bad_deploy: the last image change on shippingservice was reverted ~3h pre-onset [tr_87a2126c167b]. No evidence of memory, CPU, connection or thread limits anywhere.
open_questions: shippingservice's server span for GetQuote and its outbound HTTP child both complete without error status while only checkoutservice's client span errors [tr_4c3989b6e8d3]; the actual status code checkoutservice receives, and whether shippingservice returns a degraded/empty quote, is unsettled.

shippingservice emits no calls_total samples in either window [tr_bbe073ff1d98], so its error ratio, request rate and GetQuote latency are unmeasured and there is no metric-side confirmation of onset at the callee.
quoteservice alerted independently at 14:08:00 but was never dispatched against, so whether it is separately unhealthy or merely starved of traffic is unknown.

alternatives.root_cause: shippingservice waits on the unreachable quote host until an internal timeout, making the failure a slow-dependency stall rather than a wrong-value fault.
alternatives.why_not: Failing checkout traces complete in 8.5-11.3ms with ~2.6-3.7ms error spans [tr_4c3989b6e8d3], so callers see prompt errors, not waits.

alternatives.root_cause: The real quoteservice became unhealthy on its own and shippingservice's quote calls fail against it, with the env edit incidental.
alternatives.why_not: The configured address names a host indicated as gone rather than the live quoteservice [tr_87a2126c167b], and quoteservice alerted ~3 minutes after checkoutservice rather than before it.

proposal.expected_effect: Reverting shippingservice's config drops QUOTE_SERVICE_ADDR=http://quoteservice-gone:8090, set at 14:02:13 and never reverted [tr_87a2126c167b]. Expect shipping-service logs to resume the full 13:35 sequence (GetQuoteRequest, then quote-value, ship-order, tracking-ID) instead of bare request receipts [tr_239a7a606a6c]; checkout-service logs to resume payment/email/message-write lines after order start; and checkoutservice's error ratio to fall from ~4% back toward its ~1% baseline, with the ShippingService/GetQuote client span no longer marked ERROR [tr_4c3989b6e8d3].
proposal.if_wrong: Falsified if, 5 minutes after recreate, shipping-service still logs no quote-response lines, checkout-service still stops at order start, and checkoutservice's error ratio stays near 4%. Note shippingservice emits no calls_total samples, so callee-side confirmation is only available from logs and caller spans, not its own metrics.
proposal.risk: Restores the whole prior environment, not just one variable, so other intended env changes are silently undone. The recreate resets in-flight calls, briefly worsening checkout failures. If quoteservice is itself unhealthy, traffic returns to a broken dependency and fast clean errors may become slow timeouts. Live fault state is destroyed, leaving the unresolved status-code question unanswerable.
proposal.blast_radius: shippingservice is down for the recreate; checkoutservice sees resets, and through it frontend and loadgenerator. quoteservice sees traffic return to it, with its own health unestablished.

triage_judgement.reasoning: Critical multi-service failure starting at checkoutservice and fanning out to its downstream consumers within three minutes; nothing here can be dismissed and no open incident covers it. Fault class is not evident from the alert pattern alone, though checkoutservice is the natural first target.
